doc: Sets a player-stat halfword by index arg1: arg1==2 -> D_80084808[0]=arg0; arg1==1 -> D_8008480A[0]=arg0 then calls func_800552C8(); arg1==4 -> D_8008480C[0]=arg0 then calls func_80054D64(); any other value -> no-op.
